reviews.author: RoLit
reviews.text: Traveling from Fla back north. Woke up in the morning in the Cracker Barrel parking lot with a flat tire. Not a problem since I have a compressor, right? Wrong! The tire is off the rim, ie lost the bead. Gentleman in the parking lot suggests “Blocker Brothers” as he called them. He said he travels thirty miles just to go to them. Good enough for me. Called. Got an answering machine. Like what’s going on?!?! It’s 8:30 am. I get it I’m in the south but… walk around scratching my head. Call back and YES, got a live person. They are sending a tow truck. 10 to 15 minutes. I figured that’s it, I just hope to have enough cash… Well folks, not only did the flat bed show up in under ten minutes, not only we were taken care of right away, and I mean immediately even though the flatbed had to look for a way to wedge us into a packed lot, but the price we paid for two patches with plugs (yes the one plug was leaking and I picked up a second nail) and the tow was beyond belief reasonable. Thank you Zack and Zack’s brother ( apologize I do not remember your name) for running a business with fair prices and great service. You are what makes America Great, not the corporate bullshit stores.

reviews.author: Emma Ayala
reviews.text: I called every tire shop in the surrounding areas and this one had the best prices they got us three new tires after a blowout in under an hour. Great service kind people highly recommend!

reviews.author: DeeDee MonTess Thomas-Saxon
reviews.text: Had a blow out pulled in accessed problem. Went in office told them what happened. Within 5 mins a very handsome and friendly gentlemen changed my tire and.had.me back on the road. Very professional and dependable men working here. I highly recommend. Awesome job. Fast. Friendly.

reviews.author: Fred Fivecoat
reviews.text: Very professional and polite. Came in off the highway with a blown out tire they were very busy they made time to help us and get our RV safely back on the road.

reviews.author: Annalee Sorokach
reviews.text: We were going to go on a vacation and woke up to 2 flat tires. Called Blocker boys and they were able to tow the vehicle within 10 minutes of calling. Got it changed that hour!! 10/10 recommend!! Thank you! Very reasonable pricing!

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: Excellent customer service and good at what they do! I needed tires for my car and they had them available for a reasonable price. They were very quick and efficient with installing them! 1st time ever using them and they will be my first choice every time!

reviews.author: Patricia Dougherty
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Blocker Boys Customs. My tire went flat on my way home to Florida, and they came to my rescue when I really needed it. Everyone was so kind, patient, and genuinely helpful. What impressed me most was their honesty, they didn’t try to sell me a new tire or pressure me into anything I didn’t need. They simply fixed the problem and got me safely back on the road. Great service, great people, and a business you can truly trust. I highly recommend them to anyone passing through or living in the area!

reviews.author: Aidan Jones
reviews.text: Had two front tires that needed the tires replaced and I had a 1 hour window between getting there and need to be at my college, they had the car on jack within 5 minutes of my arrival and was done within 30 minutes . Blocker boys is the BEST tire place in walterboro.

reviews.author: Daniel Dawson
reviews.text: Best prices on tires I’ve ran across by far. Beat the big box prices by $400+ on a set of Nitto ridge grapplers and that included mount and balance. Will be my go to from now on.

reviews.author: jeff mackinnon
reviews.text: We needed an emergency tire for our 5th wheel, couldn't get it from anyone else same day. Blocker Boyz came to our rescue. Checked out the rim got us the right tire and installed it all in under an hour. Fantastic service and much appreciated. Also appreciated is the reference to them by the AAA tow truck driver who recommended BB. Thank you

reviews.author: Carolina Trace
reviews.text: Needed 2 trailer tires on trip back from Key Largo. In and out in 30 minutes. Great tire and great prices. 2 tires for the price of 1 at Mavis.

reviews.author: Kyle Warren
reviews.text: Awesome shop! Helpful and knowledgeable. They allowed me to back my 40ft hotshot trailer in to get them changed. Park around back first until they can get you in if you got a big trailer. As busy as they seem all the time, they get you in and out ASAP. I recommend them to anyone around here.

reviews.author: Chad Nathan
reviews.text: Blocker Boys’ Customs is more than a body shop, it’s where Walterboro’s rides get their personality. Where a set of wheels becomes a statement. The cars and trucks that come out of here turn heads. It isn’t just about the flash though, it’s about the craft. Custom rims and tires, stereo systems, paint jobs, everything you need to bring a vision to life. They’ve got the kind of skill that can take a beat up work truck and make it look like it just rolled off a show room floor. What I love the most is the way they treat people, whether you’re a local who’s been coming for years or someone passing through with a flat, they’ll get you back on the road with the same care. In a world where so much feels disposable, Blocked Boys’ Customs is proof that quality work still matters. That attention to detail, that extra polish, that willingness to listen to what a customer really wants, it’s all part of the reason people keep coming back. So here’s to the sound of tools, the smell of fresh paint, the shine of chrome in the afternoon sun. Here’s to the crew that turns ideas into rolling works of art.

reviews.author: Minthalee Stephens
reviews.text: On my way to work I noticed that I had a flat tire. Stopped in to Block of Boys and did not have to wait. Took care of me and in no time was back on the road. Devon was awesome. Took care of my tire problem with the utmost professionalism.

reviews.author: Guess Who?
reviews.text: I went there to get a plug in a tire until the next day when I had an appt to get new tires closer to home. The owner says I can get you 4 new tires now. I asked how much and he saved me almost 250. I would send anyone to them. I live in Charleston SC and will be back to blockers when I need tires again. Thank you for such a fast and good job. Have a blessed day.

reviews.author: Christy Knipmeyer
reviews.text: Blew a tire valve on our camper, called and they got us in and on the road quick. When I need new tires and any custom work done on my jeep, it will be worth the drive from Savannah!

reviews.author: robert engstrom
reviews.text: Wow, instant service with a smile. Looked fairly busy but they got to me right away and had my flat fixed in a few minutes. In Walterboro I won't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: Alan Ray
reviews.text: I ask for recommendations in a Facebook group for a tire shop in Walterboro to have a set of new tires mounted and balanced. Blocker Boys were recommended by the majority of folks. I was at the shop at 8:00 when they opened and they had my new tires on and I was out the door by 9:00. The price was right and and the service was very fast...maybe to fast. On my way home I was getting a lot of vehicle vibration when I would reach highway speeds, 69-75 mph. A few days later I took my truck back and told them about the shake and they took the tires off to check the balance of the tires. I was told the tires were good to go, so off I went. When I left and got up to highway speed again, the truck was still shaking. Since I was heading to Columbia, I decided to take my truck to a tire shop there to have them check the tires. Two of the four tires didn't have any balance weights on them. So, while Blocker Boys was priced fairly and their service was fast, I was disappointed they didn't do the complete job I paid them to do and had to pay another tire shop to actually balance my tires.

reviews.author: Tyler Mitchell
reviews.text: These tow truck drivers parked on MY PRIVATE property. NO PARKING zone. In front of my garage with a steel metal plate floating on the edge on my garage. After it going in the back of my car, they asked to not involve the police & to pay me cash. When I decided to go ahead and do that they change their mind saying it isn’t their fault anymore. Their insurance was also expired in 8/2024 & this happened in 9/2024. They ignored me when reaching out until calling me to be disrespectful and say it’s my fault after apologizing the day of the accident lol. Don’t use these fools.

reviews.author: Melissa Lynn Hughes Stewart
reviews.text: Fast and friendly service! Only took 11 minutes to get 1 tire replaced, from pull up to pull out! I didn't call ahead! They also were working on another vehicle when i arrived, during and after. So it wasn't as if they were dead. Very speedy! Extremely impressed!

reviews.author: allentown Gal
reviews.text: Josh was GREAT!!! They were able to quickly get me 2 new tires for my rv. ADVANCED BODY SHOPS right down the road recommended Blocker Boys and they were just as amazing!! Highly recommend both businesses!!

reviews.author: Oyku Tutuncu
reviews.text: When we hit a pothole and we were stranded in a town with no transportation or uber or taxi, Blocker Boys were so nice to order our tire right away and gave us a ride to our hotel. They made sure our car was ready first thing in the morning. Very nice people, great fast work, and affordable prices.

reviews.author: Michael J Shea
reviews.text: Drove in with a tire problem (defective steel belt). They had me back on the road within 1/2 hour with a new tire (great price). Great service and friendly workers. Thanks again guys..!!!

reviews.author: Jared Spangler
reviews.text: Josh was a big help tracking down the right tire size I needed for my truck. Definitely worth the trip out there from Summerville. The prices were great, and the service was the fastest I've ever had at a tire shop.

reviews.author: Michelle Williamson
reviews.text: Great service was on the way to the river when we needed a tire fast called blocker boys they were the only one in town that said come on we will get u in and out. 15 minutes later we was headed to the river. Will definally only use them from now on.. good work u guys keep it up.

reviews.author: Trina Mullings
reviews.text: Great fast service got us back on the road after a tire mishap from Florida to Toronto. Thank you Phillip for getting us back in the road so quickly !

reviews.author: Jason Warren
reviews.text: By far the best tire shop around!! Had 4 new tires mounted and balanced, out the door in less than 45 minutes!! And my tires were 35/12.50!!! Awesome group of people!!

reviews.author: Casey
reviews.text: Had to get new tires for my wife’s car. Excellent customer service. They got it done quick and you can’t beat the price.

reviews.author: CAMERIA GORDON
reviews.text: I was over charged for a short mileage tow! Could not even claim for reimbursement because these guys use “Eric Baileys Towing” receipts instead of their own.... My personal belongings (bags/trunk) were completely rummaged thru while in “Blocker Boys” possession and all I needed were 2 tires:( This company caused damage to my vehicle during a tire repair! I pray NO one ever gets stuck with this nightmare of a company!!!

reviews.author: jim pantas
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things! Our Van broke down on I95 towing our car trailer late one Sunday night, they picked us up, dropped us at a Hotel. The next morning they took us to a UHaul place to pick up a truck to tow our trailer and dropped our van at a local repair shop. Great folks, very helpful and extremely reasonable prices!

reviews.author: Mr. GMC
reviews.text: Its always a nice place to some but seems to be a bit of tension no welcoming spirits everything nonchalant then you got to go find someone name Josh or his brother as they always say to get anything g initiated around there... wasted a complete 20mins looking for Josh or his as they would say... seem to be a ok place to get some good tires from there... they do oil changes tires rotations truck lifts they should bring in someone to do led installs as well as audio installs and make it a full shop since it looks like west coast customs when you passing by

reviews.author: Michele Suprunowicz
reviews.text: Blocker Boys are the BEST! We had an unbelievable experience yesterday with this business and with Josh who really took care of us! We had traveled 2 days to assist our elderly parent who had an auto accident. We got caught in unbelievable traffic (Irma evacuees) and couldn't get there before closing time. Josh offered to come back and allowed us access to the car. It saved us hours of reverse travel the next day! Wish i lived local - I would use them every time - thanks so much for going above and beyond!

reviews.author: Brittany Davis
reviews.text: Coming here was like a breath of fresh air! Even though they were busy, the guys their were not slacking by far! We were in and out in no time and the customer service was excellent! I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Charity Krantz
reviews.text: I called in the middle of last week to get a quote over the phone and let the guy I spoke with know I owned a Volkswagen. He gave me a quote. When I went there he looked at my car like he didn't know how to install a Volkswagen aftermarket radio and tells me they are booked until August. Instead of lying y'all should have simply said you don't work with Volkswagens. I would much rather you say you don't know what you're doing that way it doesn't get messed up.

reviews.text: I was there in line 20 minutes before they opened and was out 23 minutes AFTER they opened...with a new tire. Fast and affordable

reviews.author: Chris Weber
reviews.text: Had a blowout on I95 passing through in the middle of the night and bent the (steel) rim slightly. After a few futile efforts in the morning to get a replacement, called Blocker Boys and they said to bring it down for a look. 45 minutes later they had the wheel fixed, a new tire mounted and I was on my way. Saved our Florida trip from major derailment! Take it from a fellow mechanic, Blocker Boys will treat you right.
